STF Officer Arrested Following Encounter, DGP Cites Evidence

A Special Task Force (STF) officer, identified as Bharat Bhushan Tiwari, has been arrested in connection with an encounter. Director General of Police (DGP) Vinay Kumar stated that the action was taken based on evidence. The encounter involved the STF and Bharat Bhushan. Further details regarding the specific circumstances of the encounter and the evidence were not provided in the coverage.
